nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the current contract owner, written in the Owned constructor and in acceptOwnership.
Public address state variable holding the pending owner, written by transferOwnership and cleared by acceptOwnership.
Public string state variable for the token symbol, set to 'SLP' in the Sleipnir constructor.
Public string state variable for the token name, set to 'Sleipnir' in the Sleipnir constructor.
Public uint8 state variable for the token decimals, set to 6 in the Sleipnir constructor.
Public uint state variable holding the fixed total supply of 1000000000000 token units.
Mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances of every holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking ERC20 allowances.
public pure helper computing c = a + b with an overflow check via require(c >= a).
public pure helper computing c = a - b after require(b <= a).
public pure helper computing c = a * b with an overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
public pure helper computing c = a / b after require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor assigning owner = msg.sender at deployment time.
onlyOwner function storing a pending _newOwner in the newOwner state variable.
Function requiring msg.sender == newOwner, emitting OwnershipTransferred and promoting newOwner to owner.
Sleipnir() constructor initialising metadata, total supply, the deployer balance and emitting Transfer.
constant function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with a raw, unchecked subtraction.
constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer debiting balances[msg.sender] and crediting balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emitting Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom debiting balances[from] and the caller allowance, crediting balances[to].
constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then performs an external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
onlyOwner function invoking an arbitrary external token contract transfer(owner, tokens).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, token debits and allowance writes.
Integer addition c = a + b inside safeAdd.
Integer subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub.
Integer multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul.
Unprotected subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply.
External call to attacker-supplied spender contract receiveApproval executed after the allowance write.
External call into an owner-supplied arbitrary token contract transfer(owner, tokens).
Unconditional revert() in the payable fallback function.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with the caller address.
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token to the msg.sender that equals owner.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Sleipnir constructor sets symbol = 'SLP'.
Sleipnir constructor sets name = 'Sleipnir'.
Sleipnir constructor sets decimals = 6.
Sleipnir constructor sets _totalSupply = 1000000000000.
Sleipnir constructor credits balances[deployer] with the whole supply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for burned tokens.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed allowance mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance mapping before the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner as the destination of the recovered tokens.
transfer delegates the debit computation to safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit computation to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates the debit and allowance computations to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the credit computation to safeAdd.
safeAdd performs c = a + b inside the addition operation.
safeSub performs c = a - b inside the subtraction operation.
safeMul performs c = a * b inside the multiplication operation.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with a raw subtraction.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on an arbitrary external token contract.
the payable fallback executes revert().
